edition.authority: Second Vatican Council; Pope Paul VI
edition.notes: The official Latin Acta constituent contains numbered articles 1-26 on printed pp. 817-830, followed on p. 830 by the promulgation formula, date, and beginning of the subscriptions. Subscriptions and notarial attestations continue through printed p. 835. The separately titled Notificatio occupies p. 836.
edition.title: Constitutio dogmatica de divina revelatione Dei Verbum

passages.context: The Constitution's complete numbered body, beginning with article 1 on printed p. 817 and ending with article 26 on printed p. 830 immediately before the promulgation formula.
passages.notes: The beginning, numbered sequence, article-26 endpoint, and transition to promulgation were checked against the exact Acta artifact; no complete diplomatic transcription or word-for-word image collation is claimed.
passages.reason: The rights record states that lawful project access to this artifact does not include redistribution from this repository.
passages.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-23 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Dogmatic Constitution on Divine Revelation, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 18 November 1965. It comprises numbered articles 1-26; edition records distinguish the Latin Acta witness from dated Vatican web delivery states and translations.
work.title: Dei Verbum
